integrity: Claims supported by a complete coordinate-wise proof and direct small-field enumeration. Publication priority is provisional; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless quivers, radical-square-zero relations, uniform unrestricted algebra elements and prime-power fields. Tutte recovery requires known vertex/arrow counts and all finite-field sizes for one tuple arity exceeding the arrow count; ordinary, not multivariate, Tutte information. No graph-isomorphism recovery.
title: Commuting-tuple probabilities of radical-square-zero quiver algebras recover the Tutte polynomial
